sentence: A pimple begins deep inside a pore, long before you see anything.
claim: Acne lesions begin as a microcomedone, a microscopic plug in the follicle, before anything is visible.
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] Microcomedone is the earliest stage; gradual accumulation of keratinous material and sebum converts it into a closed comedone. A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.

sentence: Usually, old cells drift up and out with the oil.
claim: Normally, shed follicular lining cells (keratinocytes) are carried out of the follicle with sebum.
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] Normal desquamation of the follicular epithelium; wording is a plain-language version (caption words 'drift up' per script, recognizer heard 'stripped'). A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.

sentence: But sometimes they cling together instead.
claim: In acne, follicular keratinocytes shed abnormally and cohere (follicular hyperkeratinization).
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] Hyperkeratinization / abnormal desquamation is a key step; 'cling together' is the plain-language version. A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.

sentence: Oil and cells pack into a tiny plug and the doorway starts to close.
claim: Sebum and keratinous debris form a plug in the follicle; the lesion is open or closed depending on whether the orifice stays patent.
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] Hyperkeratinization plus excess sebum forms a plug; open vs closed depending on patency of the orifice. Need a dermatologist to confirm 'doorway starts to close' wording. A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.

sentence: If the top stays open, the plug can darken in the air. That's a blackhead, and that dark color isn't dirt.
claim: An open comedone's dark color comes from oxidation of lipids and melanin in the plug exposed to air, not from dirt.
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] Sources differ in pigment chemistry detail (oxidized lipids, melanin granules); all say it is not dirt. Check the exact source before posting; wording 'darken in the air' is a simplification. A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.

sentence: If skin closes over it, it stays pale.
claim: A closed comedone (whitehead) stays skin-coloured or pale because the plug is covered by a thin layer of epithelium.
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] Closed comedones are small skin-coloured papules without a visible opening; some sources say white/yellow tint. Lay-source: replace with a dermatology source before posting. A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.

sentence: Behind the plug, oil keeps arriving. With nowhere to go, the pore slowly swells.
claim: Sebum production continues behind the plug and the follicle distends, enlarging the comedone.
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] Continuous distension widens the follicle; androgen-driven sebum keeps flowing. A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.

sentence: The microbes inside have a feast, and your body notices.
claim: C. acnes proliferates in the lipid-rich, low-oxygen plugged follicle and triggers innate and adaptive immune responses.
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] C. acnes can trigger innate and adaptive immunity. A 2024 Frontiers review argues the host response, not the bacteria alone, drives inflammation: wording 'notices' is a simplification. A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.

sentence: Immune cells gather and the spot turns red, warm, and swollen.
claim: Immune cells (neutrophils, lymphocytes) are recruited and the lesion becomes inflamed (redness, warmth, swelling).
source_title: Frontiers in Immunology 2024: immune response in acne (via search)
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] Progression is not always linear from microcomedone to inflammatory lesion; the film shows one simple path. Redness/warmth/swelling are her words; on screen only a soft tissue warmth inside the pore cut-away. A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.

sentence: That's the pimple you finally see. A small, blocked doorway… and your body, working to clear it.
claim: The visible inflamed pimple is the end of a process that began in the follicle; inflammation is part of the body's response.
note: [SOURCE-READ via search summary] Interpretive summary. Line text to be confirmed by ear (script words used where recognizer heard 'black … in your body'). A person opens the source; dermatologist sign-off required.
